subject: Term incentives & tier banding — Astra Health 2-year proposal
messages:
From: Ellis Nguyen <eng@astrahealth.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@astrahealth.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for 2-3yr options - initial ask

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our execs asked for a clean illustration of a 2-year and a 3-year advance-commit path with explicit ramp bands and the corresponding unit discounts. Key asks:
- Show annualized billing vs. full upfront for both 24 and 36 months
- Include a true-up/true-down mechanism for seasonality (we have large Q4 spikes)
- Any minimum usage floors and breakpoints that drive tiered discounts

We have procurement starting the paperwork and need a ballpark range to present on Friday. Can you send something that shows pricing bands and payment schedule options?

Thanks,
Ellis Nguyen
Head of Engineering, Astra Health
eng@astrahealth.ai

P.S. our HubSpot deal is: RDW-ACCT-7892
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Ellis Nguyen <eng@astrahealth.ai>
Cc: marcussales@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for 2-3yr options - initial ask

Ellis —

Attaching a compact first-pass (AstraHealth_2yr_offer_v3.pdf) that lays out:
- Two pricing models: annualized prepay (billed annually) and upfront prepay (billed at T0) for 24/36 months
- Tier banding with usage breakpoints at 50%, 100%, 150% of committed tokens and the associated % discount off list
- Suggested ramp schedule (Q1 40%, Q2 70%, Q3 100% for year 1) as a conservative baseline; we can tune to your seasonal Q4 profile
- True-up every quarter with a 5% floor to protect baseline economics; true-up credits applied at next invoice

Quick note for procurement: we can offer a mid-tier uplift (additional 3% discount) if Astra agrees to a split-payment schedule (50% upfront, 50% after 12 months) for a 2-year term.

If this looks reasonable I need a short internal approval for an exception to our published step-discount schedule — looping Marcus and Kimberly for sign-off (cc'd). Also dropping in a HubSpot link and a stubbed DocuSign link in the attachments.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: marcussales@redwood.com (Marcus Lin)
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing approval request — Astra Health 2yr

Naomi —

Thanks for the deck. I reviewed the banding and have two suggestions to keep the economics protected while being competitive:
1) Flatten the deepest discount (the >150% tier) by 2 percentage points and add a revenue-share cap for overages beyond 200% (we won't rebate past that without a formal amendment).
2) Approve the 3% additional discount for the 50/50 split-pay cadence, but require an SLA credit clause (0.5% monthly credit if monthly p95 latency exceeds agreed SLOs more than twice a quarter).

If Kimberly signs off on net revenue mechanics and legal confirms the cap language, I'm comfortable approving the proposal to send to Astra.

tl;dr: yes to the ask with the adjustments above.

-Marcus
VP, Sales Ops
marcussales@redwood.com
From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, marcussales@redwood.com
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-02T10:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing approval request — Astra Health 2yr

Looping in Finance (Karthik) because we need to confirm the split-pay accounting treatment and embedded true-up mechanics. My notes:
- Require a quarterly true-up window with clear reporting fields (baseline tokens, observed tokens, adjustment amount).
- Set a 4% effective discount cap for any given invoice (so stacking discounts + credits can't exceed this).
- For payment terms, 50/50 upfront + 30-day for the remainder is OK but need to add a 60-day PO acceptance clause.

Karthik — can you confirm that the 50/50 arrangement with a year-1 true-up won't create an unacceptable revenue recognition gap? If not, propose alternate timing.

Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: marcussales@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-03T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pricing approval request — Astra Health 2yr

Kimberly / Naomi —

I ran the numbers with Finance. Summary: the 50/50 upfront with quarterly true-ups is workable if we:
- Treat the second 50% as deferred revenue and run standard quarterly true-ups against it (we'll need a one-line amendment in the contract to reflect the accounting treatment).
- Add explicit invoicing fields for credits so we avoid manual reconciliations.

Recommend: include a one-paragraph revenue accounting clause and require procurement to sign the specific invoicing template (we can attach the template in the DocuSign bundle). Otherwise good to proceed.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance Processes
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Ellis Nguyen <eng@astrahealth.ai>, Astra Health Procurement <procurement@astrahealth.ai>
Cc: marcussales@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-04T13:27:00-08:00
Subject: Revised offer: Astra Health 24-month proposal (split-pay option)

Ellis / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the revised 2-year proposal (AstraHealth_2yr_offer_v3.pdf) plus the term sheet (redwood_term_sheet.xlsx). Highlights of the revised commercial:
- Term: 24 months, committed bands at 50% / 100% / 150% of commit with discounts of 12% / 18% / 22% off list respectively (note: >150% discount reduced by 2% per Marcus' suggestion)
- Payment: 50% upfront, 50% at month 12; both invoices due on receipt.
- True-up: quarterly true-up with a 5% floor; credits apply to the next invoice.
- Overages: beyond 200% usage we will invoice at a negotiated overage rate (no additional rebates).
- SLA: added an SLA credit line (0.5% monthly credit if p95 > agreed SLO twice in a quarter).
- Accounting: short revenue accounting paragraph included; procurement must confirm PO acceptance within 60 days.

Next steps: if Astra is comfortable, please confirm which payment cadence you prefer (we proposed split-pay for the additional 3% off) and we will send a DocuSign package. HubSpot deal link included: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789/RDW-ACCT-7892

Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Attachments: AstraHealth_2yr_offer_v3.pdf; redwood_term_sheet.xlsx; RDW_DocuSign_Astra_2yr_link.txt
From: Ellis Nguyen <eng@astrahealth.ai>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@astrahealth.ai, lina.park@astrahealth.ai
Date: 2026-11-05T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Revised offer: Astra Health 24-month proposal (split-pay option)

Naomi —

Appreciate the fast follow and the clarity. Team here reviewed the banding and the payment mechanics; procurement wants the split-pay option and will route for a PO. A few follow-ups from procurement:
- Can you add a 30-day window to accept the DocuSign envelope before the price is locked?
- Need clarification: if we hit >150% usage in Q4, how quickly are overage invoices generated (immediately or at quarter true-up)?

I'll push for a PO this week and confirm timeline. If you can add the 30-day DocuSign acceptance window and clarify overage invoicing cadence, we can proceed to signature.

—Ellis
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Ellis Nguyen <eng@astrahealth.ai>, Astra Health Procurement <procurement@astrahealth.ai>
Cc: marcussales@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-05T17:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Revised offer: Astra Health 24-month proposal (split-pay option)

Ellis —

Thanks — noted. We'll:
- Add a 30-day DocuSign envelope acceptance window (will reflect in the DocuSign envelope language).
- Clarify overage invoicing: standard approach is to invoice actual overages at quarter true-up, but we can issue a preliminary overage memo within 7 days of observed >150% usage; the actual invoice posts with the quarter true-up to avoid mid-quarter surprises.

I'll update the DocuSign package and send the final envelope by end of day. Marcus/Kim/Karthik — thank you for rapid sign-off on the commercial terms.

Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
